{{Quote|We do what we can to counter the evil of the Sith.|Telan Medon|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
'''Telan Medon''' was a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] from [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and the [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Port Administrator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. From [[130 ABY|130]] to [[138 ABY]], Medon repeatedly provided the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s [[Core Fleet]] safe haven from the forces of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. Medon welcomed Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] to Pau [[City/Legends|City]] in 138 ABY after a [[Evacuation of Dac|battle]] between the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and Krayt's Empire, but their conversation was secretly recorded by a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]]. Word that Utapau harbored enemies of the Empire reached Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]]; however, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] was able to [[Mission to Utapau (Second Imperial Civil War)|prevent]] the Sith [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] from [[Viral spore|poisoning]] the planet in retaliation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You've given my fleet safe haven many times these past eight years.''"<br />"''My kin have supported the Republic since before the Clone Wars. Utapau's caves can be an impossible maze. Your wounded will be safe.|Gar Stazi and Telan Medon|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
[[File:Greetingsoldfriend.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Medon welcomes Admiral Gar Stazi to Utapau.]]
The [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] Telan Medon lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and served as the [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Port Administrator]] of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], a large [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] [[City/Legends|city]] that plunged deep into the planet's surface, during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 49" /> The war pitted [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]&mdash;a [[One Sith|Sith]]-led organization that ruled much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;against several rebel factions, among them the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Medon was sympathetic to the Remnant and constantly provided its [[Core Fleet|fleet]] safe haven from [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire throughout an eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] period beginning in [[130 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 49" />

In [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes Trade">Although the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]] indicates that its events take place in [[137 ABY]], the more recently released [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 10: Extremes|''Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes'' trade paperback]] dates them at [[138 ABY]].</ref> after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] [[Final Protocol|poisoned]] the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], the Remnant [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led a massive [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] of the [[Water/Legends|water]] world<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref> and suffered many casualties during a consequent battle with Krayt's forces. Medon welcomed the fleet to Pau City in the skirmish's aftermath and personally greeted its leader, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], upon his arrival onworld. As the wounded were unloaded from the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the fleet, Stazi promised Medon that he would leave as soon as possible.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

Unbeknownst to either of them, their conversation was recorded by a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] that belonged to [[Muerdo]], an [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]]; Vedo in turn passed the information to the Sith in the hopes of luring Isen into a trap. The scientist had also [[Devastation of Da Soocha|poisoned]] the Hutt [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Da Soocha]], and, seeking revenge, Vedo hired [[Cade Skywalker]]&mdash;a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was actively [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] Sith&mdash;to [[Mission to Utapau (Second Imperial Civil War)|go to Utapau]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Isen, whom Vedo suspected would seek to punish the Pau'ans for harboring Krayt's enemies.<ref name="Legacy 49" /> Vedo's gamble paid off, and Skywalker [[Sai tok/Legends|slew]] Isen on Utapau in [[Time/Legends|time]] to save the planet from a [[Viral spore|poisonous]] fate.<ref name="Legacy 50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Utapau cannot condone the Genocide on Dac. The Galactic Alliance is welcome here.|Telan Medon, to Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
Telan Medon was sympathetic to the Galactic Alliance Remnant during their struggle against Darth Krayt's Empire and repeatedly gave their fleet safe haven from Krayt's forces over a period of eight years. As Pau'ans had previously been supportive of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a government from years past, Medon felt that aiding the Alliance was keeping with tradition. The Port Administrator additionally believed that Krayt's Sith were evil and was dedicated to countering their wickedness; Medon saw the [[genocide on Dac]] as particularly evil and, as Port Administrator of Pau City, refused to condone it.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

Medon was friendly with Alliance Admiral Gar Stazi, who was casual enough with Medon to use the Port Administrator's first name in conversation. Medon possessed [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], black and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light gray skin adorned with dark gray pinstripes.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

==Equipment==
Medon wore a set of red [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a cape and high collar.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

==Behind the scenes==
Telan Medon appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 49|forty-ninth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 49" /> on [[June 30]], [[2010]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/17-107/Star-Wars-Legacy-49---Extremes-Part-2|text=Star Wars: Legacy #49 - Extremes (Part 2)}}</ref> Although Medon shares a surname with [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]], a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era Port Administrator of Pau City who appears in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> no connection has been established between the two characters.
